fat_source.hash_basis: Read-only sha256 of the working-tree file when this record was updated. The earlier 62142-byte / 8a974fc7... hash described a previous revision and is superseded.

artifact_scope: The paths and hashes that name boot or payload images below are archived artefacts of the run they were produced by, not current build output or current device state. temporary_boot_image (57296a21..., the first restoration run), observation_boot_image (c72f67b9..., the 15-second post-parse stall build) and the auto-debug image 249b581b... are historical. 249b581b... was built while the unvalidated guessed-ramoops write block was disabled by assembly `.if 0`; that block has since been removed from the finalized loader source, so the hash does not describe the source tree as it stands. baseline_payload and payload_files are still the frozen payload used by the regression.

temporary_boot_image.build_result: package, firmware and bootimg commands all exited 0
temporary_boot_image.embedded_parts_verification: Unpacked Android image and full gzip stream; byte-for-byte equality with built FD and host-tested payload confirmed; embedded DTB header/length validated

observation_boot_image.change: 15-second bounded Boot Services Stall after successful ParseKernel, with visible DB13 success message; diagnostic-only, remove before normal boot/performance tests
observation_boot_image.payload_verification: Byte-for-byte unchanged baseline payload embedded; current built firmware byte-for-byte embedded
observation_boot_image.result: User explicitly observed DB13 parsed Success on the phone after temporary boot (Sending/Booting OKAY, exit 0). This checkpoint occurs only after successful kernel read and ParseKernel; subsequent XNU execution is not established by this image. Historical artefact: see artifact_scope.

host_regressions: First validation: 21 tests passed (historical). Published code, independently re-run on the real C: 26 tests (18 FAT + 8 DarwinBoot), 0 skipped, 0 failed. Committed host tooling in the device repository: 129 tests (53 auto-debug + 76 kmsg-ring); the 12 post-MMU-probe and 35 install-probe tests are excluded as uncommitted experimental prototypes. Compiled actual firmware C and DarwinBoot ParseKernel; real payload cluster chains and SHA256 verified.
hardware_validation: Complete for the FAT/loader objective at the time of the observation image c72f67b98f1b9d0e: it was transferred and started with exit 0, and the user explicitly observed DB13 parsed Success. That is read + ParseKernel evidence, not XNU execution. TWRP boot restoration was verified by full partition SHA256; a previous temporary run returned to TWRP and boot/recovery hashes remained correct. MMU-on, DWC3 console and userland remain unverified and outside this claim.
backup_validation: Full recovery partition SHA256 matches local 128MiB TWRP backup. Uploaded backup hash verified, wrote only verified by-name/boot (/dev/block/sde55), synced; full boot and recovery partition SHA256 both equal 8f488a0a2a766f0a1076a21be0a9f0187b2ee8e598bebd64391236b6d155fb1b after restoration.
path_note: Paths are relative to this device repository; they are build/backup locations beside it, not files published with it. Host-private absolute paths are deliberately not recorded.
